media.description: Flow diagram 'Five hops, five ways a local request fails' for pointing Claude Code/OpenCode at LM Studio: agent config, base URL, LM Studio server :1234, model identifier and loaded model, each with its failure symptom and fix.
media.ocr_text: Five hops, five ways a local request fails. Debug top to bottom. Based on LM Studio, OpenCode and Anthropic docs, Oct 2026. 1 · Agent config (settings env block or opencode.json) — Answers come from a hosted API: the local config was never loaded. 2 · Base URL (root (Claude Code), /v1 (OpenCode)) — 404 at /v1/v1/messages: remove /v1 from ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL. 3 · LM Studio server :1234 (lms server start; no auth by default) — Connection refused: run lms server start --port 1234. 4 · Model identifier (the id that GET /v1/models returns) — Model not found: copy the id; point every alias at it. 5 · Loaded model (context length and chat template) — Truncation, or tool calls as text: reload with 32,768; use a native-tool model. The first hop that fails owns the symptom; fix it before the next.
